column1: # NARRATIVA 6 (18/10/2026): ideia gnóstica por Éon, fase 3 dos Arcontes, Soter concede a leveza
# (pulo duplo), prompts curtos de ensino e falas de chegada por tipo de nó do mapa.

column2: (To sleep is to forget where you came from. Waking hurts: it is remembering.)
(Kenoma: a world full of things and empty of meaning. Nothing here feeds the real hunger.)
(The Archons rule through fate: seals, laws, chains. Whoever knows she is bound has begun to leave.)
(Before everything there was Silence. The truth does not shout: it waits to be heard.)
(To know yourself is to remember where the light came from. The reflection copies; it knows no one.)
(The body tires and rots. The spark does not: it can only be forgotten.)
(Every power that demands knees is afraid. The true Light asks for no worship.)
(the stitches of his mouth stretch; something wants out)
(The glass cracks: a white cloud. Someone small, crying.)
Just a little longer... let me sleep just a little longer.
Still hungry. Always.
If I let go... who holds me?
(a thread snaps; a sound, almost a word)
Which of us is the reflection?
All right. All right. Just one more time, then.
Rise, court! ...Rise...
Dreams of the Torpor. They pass. Try it: the Ether you gather becomes his magic.
One more thing. Be still: this does not hurt.
(His hands rest on your shoulders. A warmth rises from your feet, and the ground, suddenly, weighs less.)
Some passages are only reached with wings. Wings I don't give. I give lightness: in the air, step again.
(Light. Like before the fall.)
See that light up high? Climb to it. I'll wait.
Like that. Whoever gives wings does not fight: he only reminds you that you knew how to fly.
in the air, jump again
counter: strike now
(An unlit altar. Here no one hunts me. I breathe.)
An arena. They come in waves, and pay well whoever stays standing.
(Up high, a chamber. The only way in is stepping on the air.)
The ground here bites. Watch your step.
(The path climbs. Step by step.)
